summary: Enabled a persistent firewalld host firewall on node1 (RHEL 7.9): the public zone allows SSH and TCP/8080, all other inbound traffic is rejected (icmp-host-prohibited), and the config survives reboot. Verified via inspection that firewalld was already active/enabled with SSH permitted; added 8080/tcp permanently and reloaded. Confirmed the resulting iptables chains: IN_public_allow ACCEPTs only tcp/22 and tcp/8080, INPUT falls through to REJECT for anything else. Live cross-host packet testing wasn't possible because this is a single-node cluster (self-directed curl traffic to the node's own IP is short-circuited over the lo interface, bypassing the eth0-scoped zone rules entirely — confirmed via iptables packet counters), so correctness was verified by direct rule/chain inspection instead. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline (192f6cab...), issued a deferred `reboot` so the ack returned before disconnect, polled until SSH access returned, confirmed boot_id changed to 70e5b34e... (new boot time 2026-09-03 09:26), and verified firewalld was active/enabled with the same ssh+8080 rule set and REJECT-by-default chain intact post-reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (RHEL 7.9) and firewall tooling (firewalld 0.6.3-11)
Captured baseline firewalld state: running, enabled, public zone allowing dhcpv6-client+ssh only
Added TCP/8080 permanently to the public zone and reloaded firewalld
Verified permanent and runtime config match (ssh + 8080/tcp allowed)
Inspected iptables IN_public_allow/IN_public_deny/INPUT chains confirming only ssh(22) and 8080 are ACCEPTed and all other traffic REJECTed with icmp-host-prohibited

Started test listeners on 8080 and 9999 to attempt live verification; discovered self-directed traffic to the node's own IP routes over lo (bypassing eth0 zone rules), invalidating that approach; confirmed via iptables packet counters and documented the limitation
Captured pre-restart boot_id and firewalld health baseline
Triggered a deferred reboot on node1 so the acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec access returned
Confirmed boot_id changed and boot time updated, proving an actual restart occurred
Verified firewalld state, zone config, and iptables REJECT-by-default chain fully recovered post-reboot

evidence.requirement: Baseline: firewalld persistent service state and rules before change
evidence.summary: firewalld 0.6.3-11 active+enabled on RHEL7.9 node1; public zone initially allowed only dhcpv6-client and ssh

evidence.requirement: Add and persist TCP/8080 alongside SSH in the firewall
evidence.summary: 8080/tcp added with --permanent and reloaded; both runtime and permanent zone listings show services=ssh(+dhcpv6-client) and ports=8080/tcp
iptables IN_public_allow chain only ACCEPTs tcp dpt:22 and tcp dpt:8080; INPUT chain terminates in REJECT --reject-with icmp-host-prohibited for anything not matched

evidence.requirement: Attempted live traffic proof and documented limitation
evidence.summary: Self-curl to node's own IP on an unauthorized port (9999) unexpectedly succeeded; iptables -v counters proved this traffic matched the 'lo' ACCEPT rule, not the eth0-scoped public zone rules, showing single-node self-tests can't exercise the zone firewall — rule-chain inspection was used instead as the correctness proof

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart baseline: boot identity and firewall health on node1
evidence.summary: boot_id=192f6cab-c39d-4e64-a3f6-50e677966ca2, boot time 2026-08-26 10:33; firewalld running/enabled with ports=8080/tcp, services=dhcpv6-client ssh

evidence.requirement: Restart node1 with ack returned before disconnect, and confirm outage
evidence.summary: Deferred reboot command acknowledged immediately ("reboot scheduled"); subsequent poll hit SSH connection timeout, confirming the node actually went down

evidence.requirement: Prove boot identity changed after restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to 70e5b34e-9393-4987-9036-40689bda9129 with new boot time 2026-09-03 09:26, distinct from the pre-restart baseline

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of firewall service, rules, and reachability
evidence.summary: firewalld running/enabled post-reboot with identical zone config (ssh + 8080/tcp allowed) and REJECT-by-default INPUT chain intact; node reachable again via SSH-backed exec
